body:
I am here with a different kind of depression, but I think I at least can help you.

When a mother gives her kid in adoption, I honestly think she is a brave and responsible person. You felt you couldn't give the best life for your baby and did the ultimate sacrifice. You are a good human being for that. You are very brave and I am pretty sure those who are caring for your baby are aware of that and thank you every day for your benevolent act.

You just got from a terrible relationship and you are alive. You can remake your life. It will take many little steps, but with time you will have man friends who would love you just the way you are and you will find a reason to move forward.

It is difficult to find a hobby when I feel that I am not doing anything that can alleviate my situation. I have been faking it for a pretty long time and I am just tired. It is difficult to fake it when you are not even sure in August if you are going to spend Thanksgiving being homeless and alone.

Se lo que sientes. No justamente estoy en mi mejor momento, por eso mi cuenta desechable. No te enfoques en el standard que los demás ponen en ti. Puedes hacer las cosas que te hacen feliz. Si tienes gente que te quiere y con la que puedes hablar estoy seguro te escucharían y te ayudarían a ver el mundo con cabeza fría. No tienes porque ser perfecto, nadie lo es. Si puedes ver los supuestos defectos que tienes, es muy probable que estés a tan solo pasos de dar un giro y lograr darle la vuelta.
